description.value: Whenever struck by a melee attack, as an attack of opportunity, the forgiven cruelty will return one claw strike at 2d8+26 points of damage.

effect: Whenever struck by a melee attack, as an attack of opportunity, the forgiven cruelty will return one claw strike at 2d8+26 points of damage.

description.value: Once every 1d4+2 rounds as a full-round action, a forgiven cruelty releases a cutting winds from his wings doing 15d6 points of wind damage to all within 90-ft.-radius from him unless they make a Reflex save (DC 24) for half damage. This ability ignores the evasion class feature.

effect: Once every 1d4+2 rounds as a full-round action, a forgiven cruelty releases a cutting winds from his wings doing 15d6 points of wind damage to all within 90-ft.-radius from him unless they make a Reflex save (DC 24) for half damage. This ability ignores the evasion class feature.

description.value: Once every 1d4 rounds as a move action, a forgiven cruelty lifts off from the ground up to 30 ft. then as a standard action blasts a line radius 10 ft.-wide and 60 ft. long hitting all those within the blast radius for 12d6 points of holy damage unless they make a Reflex save (DC 24) for half damage.

effect: Move to take flight 30 ft; 10-ft-wide line.

description.value: Once every 1d4+2 rounds as a standard action, a forgiven cruelty slashes with great power towards an opponent near him. He must make a successful melee attack (+28), if he succeeds she does 12d6 points of slashing damage with a 5 round bleed doing 2d6 points of damage per round.

effect: On hit, bleed [[2d6]] each round for five rounds.

description.value: Once every 1d2+1 rounds as a standard action while mid-air, a forgiven cruelty shoots out three wind blasts from his wings. Three 45 ft.-radius cones, one in the front, left, and right that don't overlap each other, doing 12d6 points of wind damage while knocking back anyone in the radius by 30 ft. unless they make a Fortitude save (DC 24) for half damage and negates the knock back. This ability immediately lands him onto the ground.

effect: Airborne only. Three nonoverlapping cones, forward and to either side; push 30 ft on failure then land.

description.value: When below 50% health and as part of the Typhoon Wing attack, he summons 3 random orbs all within 50 ft. away from him during that attack that do another 10d6 points of wind damage to all within a 45 ft. radius around them, with a Reflex save (DC 24) for half damage. The enemies near them can only take damage from one orb.

effect: Below half HP: three orbs. Overlapping blasts hit once.
